==Biography==
Jezzi was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] living on the [[planet]] [[Ferrix]]. She was a member of the [[Daughters of Ferrix]],<ref name="Daughter of Ferrix" /> a local social club, and a good friend to [[Maarva Carassi Andor]], an elderly woman of the community and a former [[president]] of the Daughters.<ref name="Rix Road" /> 

At one [[Standard day|night]]<ref name="Andor1">{{Andor|Kassa (episode)}}</ref> in [[5 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{AndorDate|101}}</ref> Jezzi alongside [[Femmi]], brought [[Foodstuff|supper]] and medicine to the [[Andor household]]. Jezzi later returned to the residence. The next day, Maarva's adopted son [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]], who had been out of the house when Jezzi visited, questioned the family [[droid]] [[B2EMO]] as to who had visited while he was out. B2EMO mentioned Jezzi and Femmi's visit and began to explain why Jezzi had returned, but Cassian cut him off and asked specifically if anyone had come looking for him.<ref name="Andor1" /> Jezzi, along with [[Sammo]], was one of the few individuals aware that Cassian was born on [[Kenari]] rather than [[Fest]] as Maarva claimed that they were family.<ref name="Andor2">{{Andor|That Would Be Me}}</ref>

As Maarva's health worsened, the Daughters and other members of the community like [[Brasso]] tried to take care of her.<ref name="Daughter of Ferrix" /> After Maarva Andor's [[death]], they organized her [[Maarva's funeral procession|funeral procession]] and the [[Ferrix resistance movement]]. Led by Jezzi, the scope and scale of the procession acted against the direct mandates dictated by the [[Ferrix garrison|officials]] of the [[Galactic Empire]] and at the end of the procession, Maarva Andor's [[droid]] [[B2EMO]] played a [[hologram]] recording of her which denounced the Empire's actions. After the funeral turned into a a [[Ferrix Riot|riot]], Jezzi piloted a [[Breon HOY-39 Dayvan]] [[starship]] to flee the planet along with Brasso, B2EMO, [[Bix Caleen]] and [[Wilmon Paak]].<ref name="Rix Road" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jezzi was mentioned in the [[Kassa (episode)|first episode]] of the [[Andor Season 1|first season]] of the live-action television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'',<ref name="Andor1" /> which aired on [[September 21]], [[2022]].<ref name="Trailer">{{SWYouTube|cKOegEuCcfw|Andor | Official Trailer | Disney+ (2:25)|sw_url=video/andor-official-trailer}}</ref> She first appeared in the episode "[[One Way Out]]," portrayed by [[Pamela Nomvete]].<ref name="One Way Out" />
